source_title: Complexity Aspects of the Helly Property: Graphs and Hypergraphs
title: Five equivalent strong and hereditary p-Helly conditions for hypergraphs
source_author: Mitre C. Dourado; Fábio Protti; Jayme L. Szwarcfiter
difficulty_reason: The proof turns arbitrary intersection thresholds into an induced hereditary obstruction by removing the full core. It also lifts the complete p-uniform obstruction with the shifted threshold c+1, and reverses the construction by deleting edges while preserving the core to obtain p+1 private witnesses. These steps link all five original characterizations.

selected_claim: Original Theorem 8.2 with all five equivalent statements. The later recognition and complexity results are separate.
source_caveats: Use the original p3 convention of inducing on vertices for subhypergraph, and the separate edge-subfamily convention for partial hypergraph.
The proof is the full printed pp37–38 cycle. The later complexity statements are outside the selected scope.
Reference [39], printed on physical p50, is the same three authors’ On the strong p-Helly property. This fixed survey prints the selected proof.
